name: Set Actor Rotation
description: Sets an actor's world-space orientation to an absolute rotation. Feed it a Rotator; UE converts it internally to a quaternion. Returns true if the rotation was successfully applied.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: The actor whose rotation should be set. Connect a Get reference or a Spawn Actor output.

inputs.name: New Rotation
inputs.description: The new world-space rotation to apply. Connect a Make Rotator, Find Look At Rotation, or a Rotator variable.

inputs.name: Teleport Physics
inputs.description: How to handle physics state for the rotation: None (preserve velocity, smooth motion) or TeleportPhysics (reset physics state).

outputs.name: Out
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires after the rotation is applied. Continue the graph from here.

outputs.name: Return Value
outputs.description: True if the rotation was successfully set. False when sweeping is enabled and blocked.
